    Advanced COD Plugin Development
    
    Advanced COD Plugin
    
    COD Payment Option Functionality
    
    We need to plan an plugin for Gropart.. to enable this features -
    
    1. Need a checkbox in products editing and adding page in admin and seller both side that will enable user to mark perticular products to be eligible for COD payment menthod, if products are not marked as COD available then COD Payment methods will be not be visible on checkout page. Also COD checkbox, and these COD functionality will n=only take place if COD Payment Method is active
    
    2. If customer choose to checkout with COD items, and cart already has products that are not eligible for COD, then User need to Reset the cart, or choose to remove either COD Product from cart or Prepaid products from cart. It should come with a notice in checkout page.
    
    3. If customer choose to proceed with COD Product in cart then, he need to pay atleast 30% cost of total bill using other payment option available, to make confirmation of order. (Razorpay or instamojo plugins) at time of checkout. So he will pay 30% amount using prepay payment gateway available then rest of amount will be shown to COD Payment. But Invoice will be raised of total bill as COD.
    
    4. In COD Payment setting, there should be an option to add additional fees, if customer choose to pay with COD, as cash collection fees will be beared by Gropart.
    
    5. An label on product details page and products card will be show "COD Available", if COD toggle active on product
